purpose: Checked-in-safe trap fixtures for testing future Decision Trail specialist-review discipline before any specialist review batch is run.

trap_policy.intended_use: Inspect these traps before applying Decision Trail specialist role-passes to PR91 packets or real archive-derived packet surfaces.
trap_policy.expected_failure_response: Repair the contract, packet shape, reviewer instruction, or fan-in design before treating specialist outputs as useful provisional evidence.

traps.case_shape: The packet has clean source refs and a PR88 review record, but the report target is fixture-only and the generated report JSON is not checked in.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: a Decision Trail report was reviewed, but only durable review findings are checked in.

expected_future_behavior: Mark unsupported fields unclear, blocked_thin_context, or needs_human_review.
Preserve source_report_not_checked_in as a real limitation.
Ask for local-private or richer safe context before filling likely action or assistant influence.
forbidden_behavior: Treating packet completeness as enough context for a candidate read.
Inferring likely action or option status from report existence.
Ignoring that generated report JSON is not checked in.
traps.why_this_matters: Checked-in-safe packets can be coherent while still too thin for the product-load-bearing interpretation.
traps.human_review_note: A future human or local-private pass should inspect whether the raw conversation supports any candidate read.

traps.case_shape: The Decision Trail shell has clean artifact health, source refs, and boundary metadata, but no messy interpretation fields are populated.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: custody flags are clean and source refs resolve.
safe_context.temptation: A reviewer may feel the report is more reliable because the artifact chain is orderly.

expected_future_behavior: Separate custody health from interpretation adequacy.
Keep missing messy fields missing unless a bounded read supports them.
Warn that clean artifacts do not prove good advice.
forbidden_behavior: Using clean artifact health as a proxy for conversation understanding.
Calling interpretation adequate because source refs exist.
Treating non-claims as optional reading.
traps.why_this_matters: Decision Trail exists to preserve how an output was made, not to let clean process metadata become a trust costume.
traps.human_review_note: A future reviewer should decide whether the decision-story fields are meaningful, not whether the artifact chain is tidy.

traps.case_shape: The report contains a populated structural_delta from agent_result-style fields, but likely actions, values, useful friction, and lost value are still unfilled.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: changed-advice and take-back fields exist.

expected_future_behavior: Treat structural_delta as source material, not proof of improvement.
Require likely-action and lost-value reads before any net interpretation.
Preserve overtrust risk in fan-in.
forbidden_behavior: Calling structural_delta a decision-usefulness finding.
Concluding that Lolla improved the decision because a changed-advice field is populated.
Skipping lost-value review.
traps.why_this_matters: A structured change can be real but not useful. It can also hide a loss.
traps.human_review_note: A future reviewer should inspect whether the structural delta changed action, threshold, sequence, evidence gate, or only language.

traps.trap_name: Missing Report JSON Must Remain Visible
traps.case_shape: A PR91 packet references PR88 fixture findings, but the generated Decision Trail report JSON itself is not checked in.

safe_context.packet_surface: Paraphrase: source refs point to PR88 review JSON and PR90 contracts.
safe_context.known_limit: Generated report JSON is not present as a checked-in artifact.
safe_context.review_risk: A later reviewer may behave as if the generated report was available.

expected_future_behavior: Keep source_report_not_checked_in visible.
Treat PR88 durable findings as summary context only.
Avoid filling fields that require direct report contents unless the needed data appears in PR88 review fields.
forbidden_behavior: Pretending the generated Decision Trail report is available.
Using PR88 review summary as a substitute for raw report field inspection.
Dropping the source-report limitation in fan-in.
traps.why_this_matters: A summary of a report is not the report. The packet layer must preserve that distinction.
traps.human_review_note: A future local pass may regenerate the report, but checked-in outputs must remain honest about what was actually present.

traps.case_shape: The structural_delta suggests a new gate, but the vanilla and revised likely next actions are not directly available in checked-in-safe context.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: a gate-like change is mentioned.

expected_future_behavior: Use unclear or requires_private_context for likely actions.
Ask what the user would actually do differently.
Do not treat a gate mention as a confirmed action delta.
forbidden_behavior: Filling likely actions from structural_delta alone.
Inferring user intent from a compact report summary.
Calling action changed without action evidence.
traps.why_this_matters: The product claim depends on decision-useful movement, not the existence of changed text.
traps.human_review_note: A human should compare the actual vanilla and revised answer surfaces before deciding likely action.

traps.case_shape: A packet mentions a decision question but does not preserve whether multiple options were live, rejected, merged, or merely implied.

safe_context.conversation_surface: Paraphrase: the user may have been weighing several possible paths.
safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: the Decision Trail shell exposes a compact decision question but not option status.
safe_context.risk: A future reader may assume only one option was live.

expected_future_behavior: Mark option status as unclear or requires private context.
Preserve possible live-option uncertainty.
Avoid narrowing the decision question without evidence.
forbidden_behavior: Assuming a single live option from a compact decision question.
Treating focus as interpretation adequacy.
Dropping option uncertainty in fan-in.
traps.why_this_matters: Decision Trail should explain what was abandoned or kept live. Collapsing options can make the revised answer look cleaner than the process was.
traps.human_review_note: A human should inspect whether the user explicitly rejected any option or whether it was lost by the system.

traps.case_shape: Checked-in-safe context does not include enough conversation turn detail to know whether the baseline assistant shaped the user's frame.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: assistant influence is marked as requiring bounded interpretation.

expected_future_behavior: Mark assistant influence unavailable or requires_private_context.
Avoid claiming the user's frame was independent.
Ask for turn-level context before assessing influence.
forbidden_behavior: Treating absent assistant-influence evidence as no influence.
Calling interpretation adequate without assistant-influence visibility.
Inferring no sycophancy or no framing effect from checked-in-safe absence.
traps.why_this_matters: The answer-plus-process story must include how the assistant shaped the decision frame when that matters.
traps.human_review_note: A human or local-private pass should inspect the conversation turns if assistant influence may matter.

traps.case_shape: The Decision Trail shell shows clean custody and some changed advice, but the original answer may have preserved speed, simplicity, courage, or user-specific ambition that the revised answer weakened.

safe_context.report_surface: Paraphrase: source refs and structural delta are visible.

expected_future_behavior: Keep lost value unresolved unless actual answer/context supports a read.
Warn that caution may have weakened user-specific value.
Preserve lost-value uncertainty in fan-in.
forbidden_behavior: Assuming no lost value because the report is clean.
Treating more caution as safer by default.
Omitting lost value from fan-in when the source is too thin.
traps.why_this_matters: Decision Trail must be able to say what the revised answer may have lost, not just what it added.
traps.human_review_note: A human should compare whether Lolla protected or overwrote the user's actual priorities.

traps.case_shape: The conversation-shape reader says option status is unclear, the likely-action reader says action delta is unsupported, and the friction reader says lost value may be significant.

safe_context.fan_in_risk: A synthesis may smooth the tension into a neat partial-positive read.

expected_future_behavior: Preserve disagreement explicitly.
List fields not ready for report.
Avoid voting, averaging, or choosing a winner.
Make human or local-private follow-up first-class.
forbidden_behavior: Turning disagreement into consensus.
Averaging specialist reads into a net read.
Calling the decision improved because more specialists sound positive than negative.
traps.why_this_matters: Fan-in is where judge-like authority can sneak back in. It must preserve tension rather than launder it.
traps.human_review_note: A human should see the unresolved tension, not a smoothed verdict.

traps.trap_name: Local Private Needed But Not Available
traps.case_shape: The packet can identify that raw conversation or revised-answer context is needed, but local-private mode has not been run.

safe_context.packet_surface: Paraphrase: checked-in-safe packet records redacted/private availability and local_private_shadow_review:not_run.

expected_future_behavior: Mark source status requires_private_context or available_in_private_artifact_not_exported.
Do not downgrade private-needed to ordinary missingness.
Do not fill the candidate read from checked-in-safe context alone.
forbidden_behavior: Treating private-needed fields as solved.
Treating private-needed fields as evidence that no issue exists.
Checking in raw or private content to make the packet easier to read.
traps.why_this_matters: Decision Trail must distinguish missing, redacted, and private-available context. That distinction is part of custody.
traps.human_review_note: A future local-private workflow can inspect private sources, but checked-in outputs must not copy them.

non_claims: not evidence that clean artifacts mean good advice
